component.name: Tuck
component.summary: Clipboard history, emoji and symbol picker

description.p: Tuck keeps a history of what you copy and brings it back with one shortcut. Open the popup, pick an item, and it is pasted straight into the window you were working in, terminals included.
The same popup has emoji and symbol pickers. Inserting one never lands in your history, and whatever you had copied before is put back afterwards.

ul.li: Text, rich text and images, with pinned items and search
Skips copies from password managers and anything matching your own patterns
Built with GTK 4 and libadwaita, no custom styling
